summary: Complete role-based user guide for the Colour Parrot Task Management System. Covers all 7 roles (Admin/Agency Manager, Project Manager, Strategist/Sales Manager, Team Head, Specialist/Creator, HR) with detailed explanations of every sidebar tab, its purpose, what users see, what they can do, and step-by-step daily usage instructions. Includes a quick reference for task border color meanings and a troubleshooting section.
